# nightly full run: red on main (Rerun Safety)
_Swept 2026-10-17T06:46:27.351Z · [run log](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/39001012611) · commit `9ffe8af094a4c230ec1354521f2efea89eba1f7a` · conclusion `failure`._
`Rerun Safety` runs on `main` once a night, and no pull request, merge-queue build or other
scheduled run takes its measurement -- so this nightly run is the only thing that reports it, and
this card is the only channel that carries it. Nothing is blocked by it.
⛔ The remedy is never to narrow, skip or delete the failing check to make the nightly run green.
Fix what it names and let the next nightly run refresh this card; a card nobody reopens is closed by
the next green run being uneventful, not by editing this one.
